phase_name: Redeploy, schedule the call-site follow-on, and run the full gate set

objectives.description: Run deploy-headless.sh to regenerate the deployed tree
Confirm deployed verify-deploy.sh carries the new flag and selector lib present
Confirm batch still drains via orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh --dry-run
Record measured narrowed vs unnarrowed Gate 8 wall-clock

approaches_tried.reason: edge_only requires operation:target_status to resolve to the task's CURRENT status (a no-op replay), not an unconditional edge-add regardless of status. 585 was 'planned', which 'edge_only' alone resolves to 'not_started' -- mismatch, refused. Fixed by using 'postflight 585 plan <session_id>' instead, which correctly no-op-replays the existing 'planned' status while adding the edge.

approaches_tried.approach: git-commit-scoped.sh --task 584 for the out-of-scope manifest.json fix
approaches_tried.reason: the --task flag's own containment guard independently vetoes any path not in the task's declared file_scope, identical in effect to git-commit-phase.sh's Containment Self-Check. Fixed by omitting --task entirely for this one scoped follow-up commit (manifest.json is a legitimate, minimal out-of-scope touch -- see Phase 4 progress notes).

notes:
Measured Gate 8 wall-clock (this host, concurrent sibling load present throughout): unnarrowed full battery (196 suites) = 660.6s (11m0.6s). Narrowed to verify-deploy.sh's OWN 32 covering suites = 628.8s (10m28.8s, only ~4.8% faster) -- this touched path's covering set happens to include the corpus's single heaviest suite (test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh), matching shell-script-testing.md's own pre-recorded honest caveat about non-tuned many-to-one fan-out. A more TYPICAL, lighter touched path (suite-selection-lib.sh itself, resolving to 3 suites) = 17.5s, a ~97.3% reduction (~37.8x) against the same 660.6s full-battery baseline -- the representative case the narrowing exists for. Both figures are real, concurrent-load measurements, not isolated/idealized ones.

Three gate-set failures observed (41/44 passed) are NOT regressions from this task: gate3/gate5 trace to a concurrent sibling's uncommitted, not-yet-redeployed edit to scripts/lib/continuation-pointer-lib.sh (outside file_scope, confirmed via git log/status); gate8's lone NEW classification (test-gate-lock.sh) reproduces the same pre-existing, environment-dependent flakiness already documented in Phase 2, confirmed against the completely unmodified deployed verify-deploy.sh. See issues.jsonl for the full account of both.
